newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES END LOWER,TIGHTER LIQUIDITY SEEN.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES END LOWER,TIGHTER LIQUIDITY SEEN.

text.p: Hungary's overnight closed easier on Monday in a highly liquid market, traders said on Monday.
"The turnover was modest and almost nobody wanted to take up money," said Sandor Tolonics of Budapest Bank.
Overnight rates ended at 22.875 percent compared with Friday's close of 22.75/23.00 percent, but Tolonics added that market players could begin speculating on a reverse repo rate cut.
"This would again draw all available money into the (central bank's) reverse repo," he added.
